description: Create a workspace for one product or market. Set product_url to your own product so why_it_matters explains each change relative to it. Returns 422 when your plan's workspace limit is reached. To rename or change an existing workspace, use update_workspace.

name.description: Workspace name, e.g. the product or market it covers

product_url.description: Your own product's URL (e.g. example.com). The server adds https:// when missing.

name: create_workspace
title: Create workspace
